subject: Approval request: visual collateral + short excerpt for Brightlane spotlight
messages:
From: Samira Khan <samira.khan@brightlanehealth.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Cc: Brightlane Health Marketing <marketing@brightlanehealth.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 09:34:00 -0700
Subject: Request: permission to use brief excerpt + logo for Brightlane spotlight

Hi Dylan,

Hope you're well — thanks again for the product demo last week. Our marketing team would like to include a short excerpt from our conversation and Redwood's logo in a two-paragraph customer spotlight on Brightlane's site. They've attached the proposed quote and a hero image for placement.

Can you confirm:
- Whether Redwood is comfortable with a 1-2 sentence excerpt attributed to "Brightlane Health" (we've highlighted the suggested sentence in the doc)
- Permission to display the Redwood logo (small size, with white background) on the Brightlane customer page

If you need legal sign-off, let me know whom to loop in — our publishing schedule is aiming for next Monday (June 28).

Attachments: brightlane-draft-quote.docx, brightlane-hero.jpg

Thanks!
Samira Khan
Head of Marketing, Brightlane Health
samira.khan@brightlanehealth.com
+1 415-555-0138

Hi Samira (and Dylan),

Thanks for sending this over — nice concise draft. A few quick marketing edits and a request from our side:

- We suggest tightening the excerpt by changing "Redwood made deployment simpler" to "Redwood simplified deployment" (attached redline).
- For the logo: we can approve the small logo on a white background, but we ask for it to link back to https://redwood.ai/customer-stories in the live page and not be altered (no recoloring, no cropping).
- Please send the final page mock so we can confirm contrast and spacing — accessibility check.

I've attached a redline with the suggested copy change (redline_excerpt_suggestion.docx). Once Laura confirms legal language (and any required attribution changes), we can provide the high-resolution SVG and PNG of the logo.

Date: Thu, 24 Jun 2027 14:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: permission to use brief excerpt + logo for Brightlane spotlight

Hi Samira —

Thanks for the draft and image. Legal has reviewed the proposed excerpt and the requested logo placement. We're comfortable granting permission with the following conditions:

1) Quotation: the 1-sentence excerpt as redlined by Marissa is acceptable. Please retain the exact wording in the redline.
2) Attribution: the quote should be attributed to "Brightlane Health (Head of Marketing)" only — no personal employee names unless explicitly agreed.
3) Logo usage: approved for small display on a white background, linked to https://redwood.ai/customer-stories. Do not alter colors, proportions, or add overlays.
4) Duration: permission granted for 24 months from the published date; Brightlane must request renewal after that period.
5) No endorsement claim: the copy must not state endorsement beyond the quoted excerpt.

I've attached our short brand-permission-form.pdf for signature; this captures the conditions above. Please have an authorized person at Brightlane sign via DocuSign: https://app.docusign.com/envelope/EFG-788221-Brightlane-permission. Once signed, we'll provide the final SVG/PNG assets and a single-sentence approved quote for the page metadata.

If you prefer, we can route the DocuSign to Dylan to collect signatures on Redwood's side and then countersign.

--
Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0145
